{{Quote|We've got surveyors looking for ore from the Western Dunes all the way to Mospic.|Statement from the Kralkeen Mining Concern|<ref name="SWG" />}}
The '''Mospic High Range''', sometimes referred to simply as '''Mospic''', was an expanse of low, rocky outcroppings on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It marked the border between the area of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] and the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], and was home to the planet's tallest [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]].

==Description==
The Mospic High Range was a tall [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] situated near [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].<ref name="SWG" /> The [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] was also located across from it.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|333|Mos Entha}}</ref>

==History==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], after conducting a [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] with [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] in exchange for [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] traveled with [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] by [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] through the [[Xelric Draw/Legends|Xelric Draw]], a shallow, widemouthed canyon that split the Mospic High Range just inside the lip of the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="Phantom">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace'' (novel)]]</ref>

During [[Gender/Legends|his]] seventeenth [[Standard year/Legends|year]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] his [[Luke's T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]] southwest over the Mospic High Range and [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] to evade [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] fire from [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]].<ref name="Life of Luke">''[[A New Hope: The Life of Luke Skywalker]]''</ref>

During the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], surveyors of the [[Kralkeen Mining Concern]] sought [[Ore/Legends|ore]] from the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]] all the way to the Mospic High Range. Competitors of the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] firm contracted a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] to attack their surveyors and steal their claim. The attacks [[Death/Legends|killed]] or maimed a dozen of their workers. Eager to put a stop to this violence, the mining firm sent a [[Seeker (droid)/Legends|seeker]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to discover the location of the gang's hideout. Upon doing so, the firm sent out a request for a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to wipe out the gang without mercy.<ref name="SWG:CtCS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Crunch the Claim Stealers}} on Tatooine</ref>

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and a trio of [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]], including [[Emala]], [[Sligh]] and [[Grees]], took a scenic detour on their way to [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] by sweeping around the back side of the Mospic High Range to avoid a company of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout/Legends|hover-scouts]] fanning out across the flats south of the [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Mospic High Range was one of many designated [[W:c:swg:Planet|planetary]] regions in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
